title: 1 m x 1 m sightline truncation either side of a ROW or communal street driveway
text: Walls, fences and other structures truncated or reduced to no higher than 0.75m within a 1m x 1m sightline truncation on either side of a driveway where vehicle access is taken from a right-of-way or communal street (refer Figure 3.7f).

conditions.label: vehicle access from a right-of-way or communal street

replaces.note: reduced 1 m x 1 m truncation new to Part B

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: clause number reused and trigger widened. Chapter 3 C3.7.9 (p41) is the 1 m x 1 m truncation (content twin of Chapter 2 C3.7.7) and applies where access is taken from a right-of-way OR a communal street; the condition adds parking.access.street_type == communal_street. Chapter 2 C3.7.9 is the battleaxe leg width, which is Chapter 3 C3.7.13. parking.sightlines.row_truncation_1m is read as the truncation either side of the driveway at the ROW or communal street.

verified.note: Values (0.75m, 1m x 1m) and the right-of-way or communal street trigger confirmed. The page triggers on access taken from any right-of-way; the condition uses site.access_from_rear_row, so a side ROW access is missed. parking.access.street_type == row would match the page; left as encoded (pairing signature with ch2 C3.7.7).
